name: qwen3.8-27b-nvfp4.pro6000ws-2gpu-tp2-256k-fp8kv-dflash2.on-demand
purpose: On-demand 2x RTX PRO 6000 WS (sm_120) at TP=2 for Qwen3.8 27B NVFP4 (RadixArk/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4, modelopt MIXED W4A4/W8A8, ~20.4 GiB) + fp8_e4m3 KV, 256K context, DFlash2 W4A16 drafter n=7. Target ~2x single-GPU 220 decode TPS -> ~400 TPS (TP=2 halves the per-GPU weight read; all-reduce ~1 MB/step over PCIe <1% overhead). DFlash2 backport is TP-aware (all-gathers draft candidates across ranks); if TP+DFlash2 fails at boot, fall back to method=mtp n=3. Jupyter left enabled (only root-exec channel, no container SSH). gpu profile rtx-pro-6000-ws-2gpu-180gb.
